item.subject: science
item.stem:
For a school science exhibition, Meera wraps 40 turns of insulated copper wire around an iron nail and connects the ends to a dry cell. When the current flows, the nail picks up several steel paper clips. When she disconnects the cell, the clips fall off.
What do these observations show?

options.A: The coil acts as a temporary magnet only while current flows, and the iron nail makes the electromagnet stronger.
options.B: The coil acts as a permanent magnet, and the iron nail makes the electromagnet weaker.
options.C: The coil cannot act as a magnet unless the iron nail inside it heats up first.
options.D: The iron nail becomes a permanent magnet and keeps attracting the clips even without current.
